candidates.text: [September 27th, 1946] The Mayors of Halifax and Brighouse and the Chairman of Hebden Royd are appealing for funds to aid Calder Valley flood victims. Committees are managing the money. The joint fund has reached about £600, and other donations like furniture are also being received.
